Mod.name: Floor is lava
Mod.description: You can stand on physics objects, but touch the floor for too long and it turns to lava. At the start of each run, you'll find a water potion and an awkwardly shaped stone to stand on, with 10 seconds of grace. Standing on terrain or powder for a quarter of a second turns the ground around your feet into lava. The patch grows with your max HP. Hardcore mode turns that material into lava everywhere instead.
